Name: Jehoram, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoram, son of Jehoshaphat and husband of Ahab's daughter Athaliah, walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, killed his brothers, and lost Edom and Libnah to revolt.
KeyStory: Jehoram's wicked reign and Edom's revolt.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 8:16; 2 Kings 8:21; 2 Chronicles 21:1; 2 Chronicles 21:4; 2 Chronicles 21:12; 2 Chronicles 21:18
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Athaliah; Ahaziah, King of Judah; Elijah
LifeLesson: Marriage alliances shape a legacy: Jehoram imported Ahab's house into Judah, and Judah paid for it.
